text_block_list.text: I hear Winning Ticket's voice coming from the dance studio...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Toh! Hah!
Doryaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket... I have pointed this out multiple times,
but there is far too much wasted movement in your form.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Instead of going full power all the time,
pace yourself with a bit more rhythm—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you. One look should tell you everything.
—Or so I'd like to say, but you probably have no clue.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: When I first saw it, I thought it was some kind of karate kata or something too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Anyone can see that
this is a dance lesson!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I even got some advice from Hayahide,
but it's just not working out very well, you know?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Especially that final turn! No matter how many times I try, my posture completely falls apart~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey!
Trainer, do you have any advice for us?!
choice_data_list: Dancing isn't really my specialty, though...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, precisely because it isn't my specialty,
there might be things I can see that others miss."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate...
I'm definitely, DEFINITELY gonna make a total fool
of myself at the Winning Live, waaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please! Please! Pleeease!!
Think of it as saving my life!!!!
choice_data_list: You just need more fighting spirit.
You just need more fighting spirit!
You're putting too much strength into it
You're putting too much strength into it, you know

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please! Please! Pleeease!!
Think of it as saving my life!!!!
choice_data_list: You just need more fighting spirit.
You just need more fighting spirit!
You're putting too much strength into it
You're putting too much strength into it, you know

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spirit?!
I see... It's all about spirit...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Time to get focused again... Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiiiiiight, here we goooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heheh, gut feeling over logic, huh...? You two really are a match made in heaven.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. You might actually understand
Ticket much better than I do."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We look good together...!?
Good together... Good together, no way...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-You're making me blush~~!! But I'm so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, one more time!
Trainer, watch closely, okay?!

Fired up even more, Winning Ticket
nailed the final turn flawlessly this time around.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm being too tense...?
That's weird~ I didn't mean to be.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I told you as well, didn't I?
Straining yourself only leads to wasted movement."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, there's no need to make a sound
with every single movement you make.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Alright, this time I'll try doing it
just like the two of you advised!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're still tensing up a bit, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see, even more...?! Relax more...
Loosen up, loosen up, looosen up~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mnyaaaaaaah...
choice_data_list: W-Why'd you suddenly sit down like that!?
W-Why did you suddenly sit down like that!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I tried relaxing my whole body, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're cutting corners way too much.
How do you expect to dance like that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I... I... I seeeeeee!!
As expected of Hayahide, you're so smart!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To reach this level... *sniff*.
You must have studied so, so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh!!
Hayahide, you did so greaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All right, I hear you...
Let's continue the lesson, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll keeeep goiiing--!!

Having learned even a little about how to relax,
it will surely be a plus for her next dance.
